Step Description: BEFORE YOU START: The Administrator must have already added you as a Supervisor for Newberg Township Station. Log in at https://lively-bush-0ed75ca10.7.azurestaticapps.net.
Confirm the role badge on your home screen reads Supervisor.
Expected Result: Role badge reads Supervisor

Step Description: Sign in and let the home screen load.
Expected Result: Home screen shows your first name greeting and Supervisor badge.

Step Description: Count the module cards.
Expected Result: You see: Daily Check, Vehicle & Equipment Status, Check History, Station Administration, Compliance Dashboard.

Step Description: Make sure the Station Administration card is there.
Expected Result: Station Administration is visible. (Responders do NOT see this card -- that was confirmed in the Responder test.)

Step Description: Check that the Newberg Township Station band is showing in the colored bar.
Expected Result: Station name shown in the colored header band.

Step Description: From the home screen find and open the Supply Room or Station Supplies card.
Expected Result: Supply Room screen opens. You see a View Supplies button and a Count Supplies button.

Step Description: Tap View Supplies.
Expected Result: A shelf-by-shelf list of items appears. Items are grouped under shelf names (Shelf 1 through Shelf 4 or similar).

Step Description: Look at the quantities shown for items on each shelf.
Expected Result: Each item shows how many are currently on hand, compared to min and max levels.

Step Description: Look for any low-stock alerts (amber or red indicators).
Expected Result: If any item is below its minimum, a warning badge or color is shown next to it.

Step Description: Look for any items marked as Damaged.
Expected Result: If any item has a damage flag, a Damaged badge appears on that row.
Tester Notes: There isn't filtering on the Station Supplies

Step Description: Go back to the Supply Room home. Look for a low-stock summary panel on the page.
Expected Result: A supply alert panel is visible (amber items and red items are called out separately if applicable).

Section: 3. Receive New Stock (Add to Supply Room)
Step Description: From the Supply Room tap Count Supplies or a Receive Stock button.
Expected Result: The supply count / receive stock screen opens.

Section: 3. Receive New Stock (Add to Supply Room)
Step Description: Find a way to add a new lot of NRB Masks. Enter: Lot # = UAT-LOT-01, Quantity = 25, Expiry = 12/31/2028.
Expected Result: New lot appears in the NRB Mask section of the supply room.
Tester Notes: Need to be able to search View Supplies

Section: 3. Receive New Stock (Add to Supply Room)
Step Description: Look at the NRB Mask on-hand total after adding the lot.
Expected Result: The on-hand quantity increased by 25 (or the total now reflects the new lot).

Section: 3. Receive New Stock (Add to Supply Room)
Step Description: Look for a Transfer History or Inbound Log section.
Expected Result: The new lot receipt appears as an inbound transfer record.
Tester Notes: I added the NRB masks, but transfers are not showing.

Step Description: From the Supply Room screen tap Count Supplies to start a supply count check.
Expected Result: The check wizard opens. Step 1 shows the supply room location (not a vehicle picker).

Step Description: Proceed to the shelf list (Step 2).
Expected Result: Shelves appear as compartments. Each shelf shows items to count.

Step Description: For NRB Mask enter the quantity you see on the shelf (use 25 since you just received them).
Expected Result: NRB Mask row shows green OK or the quantity is accepted.
Tester Notes: I can't update the numbers.  The buttons don't work.  The - and + or the number or the "All 1 present".  The "# item not yet reviewed" does show that it is being decremented.  Just the screen isn't being updated for the counts.

Step Description: For one item enter a quantity below the minimum (for example 1 when the minimum is 20).
Expected Result: That item row turns amber or red to indicate a shortage.

Step Description: Complete all shelves and proceed to review and submit.
Expected Result: Check submits. You return to the supply room home or a confirmation screen.

Step Description: Check the Compliance Dashboard after submitting.
Expected Result: The supply room check appears as a completed check for today.

Step Description: Return to the Compliance Dashboard. Look for an Expiring Items or Expiring Soon panel.
Expected Result: Panel is visible, even if collapsed. If items are expiring in the next 30-90 days they are listed.

Step Description: Expand the panel if it is collapsed.
Expected Result: You see a list of items with their expiry dates and locations.

Step Description: Confirm any AED Pads items are listed if their expiry date is approaching.
Expected Result: AED Pads Adult and/or Pediatric appear in the list if their dates are within the alert window.

Step Description: Open the Compliance Dashboard.
Expected Result: Dashboard opens for Newberg Township Station.

Step Description: Look at the summary tiles at the top.
Expected Result: Tiles show counts for Pass, Fail, Needs Restock, Not Checked today.

Step Description: Tap the Not Checked tile.
Expected Result: Only vehicles that have not been checked today are shown in the list below.

Step Description: Tap the All tile.
Expected Result: All vehicles shown again.

Step Description: Look for Unit 712 in the vehicle list.
Expected Result: Unit 712 card shows its most recent check status for today.

Step Description: Scroll below the vehicle cards on the dashboard to find the calendar.
Expected Result: Calendar is visible. It shows the current week Monday through Sunday.

Step Description: Find today's column.
Expected Result: Today's date has a highlighted circle or distinct visual marker.

Step Description: Look at Unit 712's row for today. If a check was submitted, you should see a green check mark.
Test Data / Setup Needed: Unit 712 check must have been submitted today (by you or by a Responder)
Expected Result: Green check in today's cell for Unit 712.

Step Description: Look at any day earlier this week when no check was done.
Expected Result: That cell shows a red or orange indicator -- it was not checked.

Step Description: Tap the green check mark on Unit 712 today.
Expected Result: Check Detail Panel opens showing the check results for that submission.

Step Description: Close or go back from the detail panel.
Expected Result: Calendar is still there. Nothing reset.

Step Description: Tap the Month button on the calendar.
Expected Result: Calendar switches to a full month view. Header shows the current month and year.

Step Description: If a vehicle chip filter appears at the top (e.g., Unit 712), tap it.
Expected Result: Only Unit 712's row is shown. Other vehicles are hidden.

Step Description: Tap Unit 712 chip again.
Expected Result: All vehicle rows return.

Step Description: Tap the Week button.
Expected Result: Calendar switches back to week view.

Step Description: Navigate to the most recent check for Unit 712 on the dashboard. If it is a FAIL or NEEDS_RESTOCK, open it.
Test Data / Setup Needed: A FAIL or NEEDS_RESTOCK check must exist for Unit 712
Expected Result: Check Detail Panel opens. You can see which items failed.

Step Description: Look for the "I Fixed This" or resolution button in the detail panel.
Expected Result: Button is visible. (If the check already passed, skip to SUP-42.)

Step Description: Tap the button, enter a resolution note of at least 5 characters, and submit.
Test Data / Setup Needed: Resolution note: Restocked NRB masks from supply room
Expected Result: Check is marked acknowledged. Green confirmation appears.

Step Description: Go back to the dashboard. Look at Unit 712's card.
Expected Result: No "Needs Acknowledgement" badge showing. Card is resolved.

Step Description: From the home screen open Vehicle & Equipment Status.
Expected Result: Vehicle list shows. Each vehicle card shows its name and any open repair badges.

Step Description: Check if any vehicle shows an open repair request badge (orange wrench or similar).
Expected Result: If none exist, file one in the next step.

Step Description: Open Unit 712. Tap File Repair Request. Enter Description: Stretcher mount loose. Priority: Routine.
Expected Result: Repair request is filed. It appears in the list for Unit 712.

Step Description: Tap the repair request you just filed.
Expected Result: You can see the full detail: description

Step Description: Change the status to In Progress. (Look for a status button or dropdown.)
Expected Result: Status updates to In Progress.

Step Description: Resolve the repair: tap Resolved, enter notes: Tightened all four bolts. Status: Fixed.
Expected Result: Status changes to Resolved. The repair request is marked closed.

Step Description: Go back to the Vehicle & Equipment Status list.
Expected Result: Unit 712 no longer shows an open repair badge (since you resolved it).

Step Description: In the compliance dashboard open the most recent check for Unit 712. Find an item in the detail view.
Expected Result: Item detail is visible.

Step Description: In the check wizard (start a new Daily Check on Unit 712), find an item in a compartment. Look for a way to mark it damaged.
Expected Result: A Mark Damaged button or option is available on the item row.

Step Description: Mark one item as Damaged during the check.
Expected Result: Item row shows an orange Damaged badge.

Step Description: Submit the check.
Expected Result: Check submits. The damaged item's status is recorded.

Step Description: Open the Supply Catalog view in Station Administration or Supply Room.
Expected Result: The damaged item shows a Damaged badge in the catalog.

Step Description: Open Station Administration > Members.
Expected Result: You can view the member list.

Step Description: Look for an Add Member button.
Expected Result: Add Member button is visible for a Supervisor. (Supervisors can add members.)

Step Description: Check whether a Deactivate Station button is visible.
Expected Result: Deactivate Station is NOT available to a Supervisor. Only the Administrator can retire a station.

Step Description: Open Settings.
Expected Result: Settings screen opens. You can see the current Allow Check Modification setting, but it is read-only. No toggle.

Step Description: Look for any Retire Vehicle or Retire Station buttons in Settings.
Expected Result: Retire buttons are NOT visible to a Supervisor.

Step Description: Go back to the home screen. Start a Daily Check.
Expected Result: Step 1 shows vehicles. Look for Unit 712 Jump Bag listed as a selectable location.

Step Description: Tap Unit 712 Jump Bag to select it.
Expected Result: Jump Bag is selected. The Continue button activates.

Step Description: Proceed through the check wizard for the Jump Bag.
Expected Result: Compartments appear for the Jump Bag (e.g., Outer Pocket, Main Compartment).

Step Description: Complete and submit the jump bag check.
Expected Result: Check submits. Jump Bag check appears on the compliance dashboard.

Step Description: From the home screen find and open the After-Call Usage Log (may be labeled Usage Log or After Call).
Expected Result: Usage log screen opens.

Step Description: Look at the vehicle picker (if the station has multiple vehicles).
Expected Result: Unit 712 is listed as a vehicle option. (If only one vehicle, this step may be skipped automatically.)

Step Description: Select Unit 712 and proceed to the item picker.
Expected Result: Item picker opens. You see "Used most often" or a list of common items.

Step Description: Tap the + button next to NRB Mask. Set quantity to 2. Tap + next to BVM. Set quantity to 1.
Expected Result: Both items appear in the selected section with their counts.

Step Description: Look for a way to add a note for the whole usage event (optional notes field).
Expected Result: A notes field is available.

Step Description: Tap Done or Submit Usage.
Expected Result: Usage log submits. A confirmation screen or success message appears.

Step Description: Go to the Supply Room. Check the NRB Mask on-hand quantity.
Expected Result: Quantity has decreased by 2 from what it was before the usage log (FIFO decrement happened).

Step Description: Return to the After-Call Usage Log. Look for a History or Previous Logs section.
Expected Result: Usage history is viewable.

Step Description: Find the event you just submitted.
Expected Result: Event appears with date, your name, vehicle, and items used.

Expected Result: Deactivate button is NOT visible. Supervisor can edit items but cannot deactivate them.

Step Description: Look for a + Add Station button in the station list.
Expected Result: #NAME?

Step Description: Look at Station Administration for any Retire Station button.
